test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A thing fit to eat.
solution: The correct answer is "**Edible.**" [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Let us understand the meanings of the given options: • Eligible means having the right to do or receive something. (कुछ करने या प्राप्त करने का अधिकार होना।) • ​Example: You are eligible for the job. • Digestible means capable of being digested or broken down by the body. (शरीर द्वारा पचाने या तोड़ने में सक्षम)​ • ​Example: The food over there was not digestible. • ​Curable means able to be cured or treated successfully. (ठीक किया जा सके या सफलतापूर्वक इलाज किया जा सके) • ​Example: Many types of cancer are curable. • **Edible means fit to be eaten or suitable for consumption**. (खाने योग्य या उपभोग के योग्य) • Example: The berries on this tree are edible, but the leaves are poisonous. • Thus, it can be concluded that the word "edible" can substitute the given phrase. Hence,** the correct answer is option 4**. 1a4:T5bc, The correct answer is "**Not brave**".
